messages:
Harsha Iyer: Hey folks, PR for the migration examples is failing CI (linkcheck + markdownlint). Need a quick triage before the PM review at 10am.
Lena Morgan: PR link?
Harsha Iyer: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4360. CI says: linkcheck (2 broken externals), markdownlint MD013 (long line), and preview: code fence missing language.
ci-bot: PR #4360 checks: linkcheck: failed (https://example.com/redis-ops -> 404; https://old.example.org/kv -> 404), markdownlint: failed (MD013 line 134), docs-preview: failed (snippet at docs/migration/kv.md missing language tag).
Lena Morgan: I can swap the first link to our internal example repo (github.com/redwood-inference/examples/redis-kv). For the second, is there an internal mirror?
Harsha Iyer: No mirror. Use web.archive.org snapshot as temporary fix and file a follow-up to track canonical replacement.
Theo Lin: I'll push a tiny commit: add ```bash to the snippet around the redis CLI, wrap long lines at ~80 cols, and replace the two links accordingly.
Lena Morgan: For MD013, check other paragraphs for super long sample outputs; we should prefer code blocks for those instead of wrapped inline text.
Theo Lin: ack. Also ran `pre-commit run --all-files linkcheck markdownlint` locally before pushing. Local run caught an extra trailing space that Markdownlint flags.
docs-bot: Note: editorial/lint-only PRs should get `docs:quick-merge` label and ping the approvers group.
Harsha Iyer: This is editorial only. Once CI passes, please add the label and @docs-approvers.
ci-bot: Running checks on updated patch...
ci-bot: linkcheck: passed; markdownlint: passed; docs-preview: success -> preview at https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4360
Lena Morgan: Preview looks good. Syntax highlighting fixed.
Theo Lin: LGTM. I'll request approval and tag `docs:quick-merge`.
Harsha Iyer: Added labels and pinged approvers. If green, can we target merge at 9:40 so PM has time to review before 10am?
Lena Morgan: I'm available for a rapid review at 9:45.
docs-bot: Reminder: for quick-merge use squash with commit message: "fix(docs): lint/link fixes for KV migration examples"
Harsha Iyer: Thanks team  merging at 9:40 PT if approver confirms.
Theo Lin: Approver approved at 9:38 PT. Merged.
Harsha Iyer: Great! I'll tell the PM and mark the follow-up ticket to replace the archive link with a canonical source.
Lena Morgan: Nice turnaround. Will watch for any regressions in staging preview.
